changes.title: Registry place: the page speaks the server's commands, stricter password check [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Two faults found by the workers' own reports, repaired.

The settings page called seven commands that did not exist; it had been ordering from a menu the kitchen never printed. It now uses the ten commands the server really offers, and both sides hold the same hand-written list with a test that fails if either drifts. No command carries a password: changing it opens the integration's own flow.

The password check was length times alphabet with a short blacklist, so "Capitalword2024word" passed. It now prices dictionary words, years and dates, keyboard runs, sequences, repeats and leetspeak, and takes the cheapest way to guess. That example scores 33 bits and is refused; the bar is 60. Five uncommon words still pass. Known limit: two unlisted words joined together can still pass.

243 Core tests passed and 15 frontend tests passed. Not seen in a browser. Two packaging check findings remain (manifest categories and the quality scale level).
changes.detail_yue:
登記處存放位：頁面講返伺服器嘅指令，密碼檢查嚴啲。工人自己報告 搵到嘅兩個毛病，修好。

設定頁之前叫緊七個唔存在嘅指令，等於照住廚房冇印過嘅餐牌落單。 而家用返伺服器真係有嘅十個指令，兩邊各自有同一份人手寫嘅清單， 有測試守住，任何一邊走樣都會失敗。冇任何指令會帶住密碼：改密碼 會開整合自己嘅流程。

密碼檢查之前只係長度乘字符種類，加一張好短嘅黑名單，所以 「Capitalword2024word」過到關。而家會計字典字、年份同日期、鍵盤 連打、順序、重複同火星文，再揀最平嘅估法。嗰個例子得 33 位元， 會被拒絕；門檻係 60。五個冷門字仍然過到。已知限制：兩個唔喺清單 嘅字連埋一齊仍然可能過到。

Core 測試 243 個通過，前端測試 15 個通過。未喺瀏覽器睇過。仲有 兩個封裝檢查發現未處理（清單類別同品質等級）。

changes.title: Docs: record build 526, what was seen and what was not [skip ci]
changes.detail: Handoff, roadmap, feature status and the feature pages now describe the tree as it shipped in build 526: what was proven in a browser, what was proven only against pretend hosts, and what nobody has looked at yet. An honest "not seen" ages better than an optimistic tick.
changes.detail_yue: 文件：記錄第 526 版，睇過咩同未睇過咩。交接、路線圖、功能狀態同 功能頁而家照第 526 版出貨嘅樣寫：邊啲喺瀏覽器證實過，邊啲只對住 假主機證實過，邊啲仲未有人睇過。老實寫「未睇過」，放耐咗都好過 樂觀剔個剔。
